attachments.document_title: Record of the claim notification: the CSS form 'Schadenanzeige Hausrat / Gebäude', or CSS's record of an online, written or oral notification
attachments.label: A1
must_show: that and when CSS was notified of the theft

that an official investigation was requested
attachments.text:
Zuger Polizei – Polizeiposten Zug
Police report (Polizeirapport), translation

File no.: ZUPO 26-01-1547
Report made: 29.01.2026, 19:10, at the Zug police post
Complainant: Isla Egli, Gartenstrasse 81, Baar

Facts as stated: On 29.01.2026 between approx. 07:30 and 18:30 the complainant's bicycle (women's gravel bike, white, drop handlebars, mudguards) was stolen from the covered bicycle parking at Zug railway station, west exit.

The complainant requests a criminal investigation and files a criminal complaint against the unknown perpetrator. The bicycle has been entered in the police search system.

Polizeiposten Zug

questions.label: Q1
questions.question: Does the policy, or the file, show that the policy does not include the separate supplementary insurance for simple theft away from home (einfacher Diebstahl auswärts)?

questions.label: Q2
questions.question: Does the file state that the measures could not wait for the insurer's instruction because of imminent danger (Gefahr im Verzug)?

questions.label: Q3
questions.question: Does the file state that the original purchase vouchers for all of the stolen or damaged items cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost (not even as a duplicate from the seller)?

questions.label: Q4
questions.question: Is a bicycle among the stolen or damaged items?

questions.label: Q5
questions.question: Does the file state that measures to reduce the loss are still to be taken (not yet carried out)?

questions.label: Q6
questions.question: Does the file state that traces of the theft (for example pry marks, a broken lock, window or container) have been removed or altered, or are to be removed or altered, by the policyholder or on their behalf, for example by repair or cleaning?

questions.label: Q7
questions.question: Does the file state that household contents were stolen or damaged by a theft outside the insured location that was neither a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery; a vehicle is not a container) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death; pickpocketing and trick theft are not robbery)?

text:
Dear Mr Weber,

I'm attaching the confirmation CSS sent me when I first reported this on the phone, and the police report from Zug.

On Thursday 29 January 2026 I took the train from Zug to Zürich for work, as I do three days a week. I'd ridden from Baar to Zug station in the morning and left my bike in the covered bike parking by the west exit. When I came back at about 6.30 in the evening it had gone.

The bike is a white women's gravel bike with drop bars and mudguards, a regular bicycle without any motor, worth CHF 2,205.

I still need to enter the frame number in one of the online stolen-bike registers. My partner Leo Suter keeps telling me to, and I haven't got round to it yet. I'll do it this week, it might help it turn up.

I'm afraid there are no receipts. I bought the bike second-hand from a private seller in April 2025 and paid in cash, and he never gave me anything in writing. I don't know his full name, so there's no chance of getting a copy.

I do have the supplementary cover for simple theft away from home on my household policy, since May 2025. I took it out partly because of this bike, so I'm hoping it will help now.

Thank you,
Isla Egli
Gartenstrasse 81, Baar
